summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed an amended and restated Q2 fiscal 2026 interim financial statements and MD&A on Form 6-K, correcting presentation and classification matters in previously filed statements. Corrections included revaluation loss on digital assets, earnings per share, cash flows, equity changes, fair value of cryptocurrencies, stock option grants, and subsequent events. No changes to total comprehensive loss, assets, liabilities, or equity. No special situation event. This is a routine corrective filing, not a special situation.
